# 2026 Apple Photos Local Gap Audit

Status legend: `[ ]` not started, `[~]` in progress, `[x]` implemented or already covered.

Audit date: 2026-06-19
Deep refresh: 2026-06-19, with fresh Apple Support research and three read-only subagent audits.
Continuation audit: 2026-06-19, with direct Apple Support spot checks, current repo evidence checks, and an independent doc-consistency subagent pass.
Comprehensive audit addendum: 2026-06-19, with fresh official Apple spot checks, frontend/backend/test subagent audits, and scale-risk review.
Scope: local/offline features Apple Photos has that the Vintrace Photos tab does not yet have, or only has partially. Cloud sync, shared libraries, Apple-only services, and multi-device collaboration are noted separately instead of treated as first-wave goals.

## Executive Summary

The current Vintrace Photos tab is no longer a bare gallery. It already has All Photos from canonical local `photo_assets`, people folders, unknown clusters, local Places, Favorites, Hidden, Recently Deleted, Recently Edited, media-type collections, exact-hash and perceptual near-duplicate Duplicates, custom smart albums with a visual grouped-query builder, manual albums, nested album folders, album covers, smart suggestions, date modes, row virtualization, selection, keyword tools, editable metadata, XMP sidecar import/export, saved-search smart albums, export/copy/move bundles, and Review handoff.

Apple Photos is still broader in six major ways:

1. Library primitives: Apple has a full photo-library data model with editable metadata, favorites, hidden/deleted states, manual albums, album folders, imports, media-type collections, utility collections, and richer export options.
2. Search and organization: Apple supports global search, filters, dates, places, keywords, captions, favorites, people/pet management, group albums, smart-album criteria, and content-based utilities.
3. Navigation and scale: Apple has Years/Months/All Photos navigation, Recent Days, pinned collections, reorderable sections, map/trip summaries, thumbnail density controls, and a mature large-library browsing model. Vintrace also adds a useful local Days mode.
4. Safety utilities: Apple has Duplicates, Hidden, Recently Deleted, Recovered, locked utility albums, and clear restore/permanent-delete semantics.
5. Local intelligence: Apple offers Live Text, Visual Look Up, subject isolation, receipts/documents/QR/handwriting/illustration collections, and memories/trips.
6. Editing and media tools: Apple has non-destructive photo/video editing, Live Photo handling, video frame export, markup, slideshows, memories, print/share/export workflows, and library management.

The recommended build order is not to copy the UI first. Build the local library foundation first: keep hardening `photo_assets` as the read model, deepen import-library UX around the explicit import command, broaden metadata extraction, add scale/perf coverage, and keep stress-testing the now-wired manual album ordering plus smart-query DSL. Most Apple-parity features become straightforward once those primitives exist.

This document is now the cross-off control sheet for Photos parity. Do not mark an item `[x]` until the implementation, tests, and rolling evidence are updated in this file.

## Apple Photos 2026 Source Baseline

Apple Photos currently spans more than a gallery. The local features that matter for this app fall into these buckets:

- Library navigation: Library, Years, Months, All Photos, Recent Days, Collections, collapsible/reorderable sidebar sections, Pinned collections, thumbnail zoom, square/aspect thumbnails, collection display size/collapse controls, and hide-screenshot/shared-item display toggles. Vintrace's Days mode is a local enhancement rather than a direct current Mac toolbar parity item.
- Organization: manual albums, albums from selection, album key photos, album folders, nested folders, album rename/duplicate/merge/sort/reorder, Smart Albums with one or many criteria, saved criteria by title/date/person/media/favorite and more, and photo membership in multiple albums.
- Search and filters: search by title, caption, keyword, date, location, text inside photos, objects/scenes, people, events, and shared-library participant; suggestions while typing; multi-criteria queries; natural-language search and key-video-moment search where Apple Intelligence is available; collection filters for Favorites, Edited, Photos, Videos, Screenshots, Not in an Album, and keywords.
- People, pets, and groups: People & Pets collection, people/dog/cat grouping, name/change labels, key photo, favorite people, alphabetical/manual people sort, hide/remove people, merge duplicate people/pets, review more suggested photos, feature-less curation, and first-class groups by any combination of people/pets.
- Places and time: map view, location clusters, nearby photos, map/satellite/grid modes, date drilldowns, trips, years/months/day summaries, and best-photo summaries.
- Utilities and safety: Favorites, Hidden, Recently Deleted, Duplicates, Recently Saved, Recently Edited, Recently Viewed, Recently Shared, Documents, Receipts, Handwriting, Illustrations, QR codes, Recovered, locked Hidden/Recently Deleted, restore, permanent delete, duplicate merge, and reorderable Utilities/Media Types lists.
- Metadata: title, caption, favorite, date/time/time-zone adjustment, location add/change/hide/revert, keywords, keyword manager, quick-pick keyword shortcuts, EXIF/camera/lens/file/device info, dimensions, duration, codec, album membership, shared/import source, Visual Look Up detections, event details, and searchable metadata.
- Local intelligence: Live Text OCR and actions, Visual Look Up-style labels, subject isolation/cutout, subject-sticker creation, object/scene search, natural-language search where local model support is feasible, wallpaper/collage suggestions, and content curation preferences.
- Editing and media: non-destructive edit stack, undo/revert original, duplicate version, compare original/edited, copy/paste adjustments, crop/straighten/rotate/flip, filters, light/exposure/color adjustments, curves/levels, white balance, definition, selective color, noise reduction, sharpen, vignette, red-eye, retouch/cleanup, markup, video playback/scrub/trim, video still-frame export, poster frames, Live Photo handling/export, RAW handling, bursts, Portrait/Cinematic/depth controls where metadata exists.
- Memories and output: memories, memory movies, user-created memories, memory personalization, feature-less feedback, instant slideshows, saved slideshow projects, music/titles/transitions/duration, export memories/slideshows, print/contact sheets, share-sheet integrations, original export, rendered export, metadata/XMP export, file type/quality/size/color-profile choices, filename/subfolder naming patterns, reveal/open-with.
- Library operations: import from camera/phone/storage/folders/apps/other library, managed vs referenced files, referenced-file consolidation, import history, Last Import/Imports/Recently Imported, missing-file relink, multiple libraries/library roots, library health/repair, backup/restore, Recovered items, and storage-location controls.

Cloud sync, iCloud Shared Photo Library, Shared Albums, iCloud links, AirDrop's exact transport, Apple Watch faces, Apple Music memory soundtracks, Face ID / Touch ID's exact unlock UX, Apple Intelligence as a dependency, and professional print ordering are real Apple Photos capabilities, but they are not first-wave local goals. Build local analogues only where they do not create a cloud dependency.

Important integration boundary: the current Photos tab is a local Vintrace catalog backed by workspace state and local files. It is not a native Apple Photos database client, does not use PhotoKit/`PHPhotoLibrary`, and does not sync iCloud Photos or Apple shared libraries. Native Apple Photos library access may become a future import adapter, but local parity work should not depend on it.

## Local Integration Boundary

| Class | Build stance | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| Local first-wave | Integrate directly in the Photos tab. | Library/import model, date views, pinned/reorderable rail, albums/folders/smart albums, metadata/search/keywords, Hidden/Recently Deleted, duplicates, Places, export, keyboard shortcuts, tests. |
| Local plus optional ML | Integrate behind explicit local settings, background queues, progress/error state, and no-network tests. | OCR/Live Text, documents/receipts/QR/handwriting/illustration utilities, object/scene tags, subject isolation, subject-sticker export, semantic search, pet profiles, Memories scoring, wallpaper/collage suggestions. |
| OS/device analogue | Implement where Electron/macOS can support it, but do not promise exact Apple behavior. | Share sheet, reveal/open-with, local print/contact sheet, Live Photo pair handling, burst stack handling, RAW rendering, video transcode/still export, map rendering. |
| Defer / out of scope | Do not block local Photos parity on these. Track only if a future cloud/collaboration product exists. | iCloud Photos sync, Shared Albums, iCloud Shared Photo Library, iCloud links, AirDrop exact transport, Face ID / Touch ID exact unlock, Apple Intelligence as a dependency, Apple account collaboration, Apple Music integration, professional print ordering. |

## Integration Sequence

Highest leverage local parity should land in this order:

1. P0 foundation: `APL-LIB-01`, `APL-LIB-02`, `APL-LIB-04`, `APL-TEST-01`, `APL-TEST-03`, and `APL-TEST-05`. Finish the canonical asset read model, import sessions, and migration/perf coverage before adding heavier UI.
2. P0 organization: `APL-ALBUM-02`, `APL-ALBUM-07`, `APL-SMART-01`, `APL-SMART-02`, `APL-SEARCH-01`, and `APL-SEARCH-02`. This gives users Apple-like organization without ML risk; `APL-ALBUM-03` album folders is already complete and should only get polish.
3. P0/P1 safety: `APL-UTIL-03`, `APL-UTIL-04`, and `APL-SAFE-01`. Finish Hidden, Recently Deleted, broader OS-backed/biometric auth decisions beyond the macOS Touch ID bridge/local passcode, repair/recovery flows, and broader undo semantics.
4. P1 people/places: `APL-PEOPLE-01` through `APL-PEOPLE-06`, `APL-PLACE-01` through `APL-PLACE-05`, and `APL-DATE-01`. This turns face/place data into Apple-style browsing surfaces.
5. P1 export/media: `APL-EXPORT-01` through `APL-EXPORT-05`, `APL-OS-01`, `APL-OS-02`, `APL-VIDEO-01`, and `APL-VIDEO-03`. Fill the everyday "get this out / play this properly" gaps.
6. P1/P2 local intelligence and editing: `APL-INTEL-*`, `APL-EDIT-*`, `APL-LIVE-01`, `APL-RAW-01`, `APL-MEM-*`, and `APL-SHOW-*`. These should be background-job driven and privacy-tested.

## Local Scope Rules

In scope for this audit:

- Local SQLite-backed library state.
- Local files and watched folders.
- Local metadata extraction and sidecars.
- Local ML/OCR/classification where model size and runtime are acceptable.
- Local map/grouping from EXIF GPS, with optional offline map rendering later.
- OS-level integrations that work without cloud dependency, such as open/reveal/print/share-sheet hooks.

Out of scope for first-wave parity:

- iCloud Photos sync, Optimize Mac Storage, shared libraries, shared albums, iCloud links, and cross-device state.
- Native PhotoKit/`PHPhotoLibrary` sync with Apple Photos. Treat Apple Photos libraries and protected folders as possible import sources only; explicit permission guidance now exists for package/protected-folder imports.
- Apple Intelligence services as a dependency. We can build local equivalents, but not rely on Apple's private stack.
- Professional print ordering.

## Existing And Target Data Model

Already present in the current worktree:

```sql
photo_assets(
  asset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL,       -- managed | referenced
  file_signature_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  content_hash TEXT,
  perceptual_hash TEXT,
  media_kind TEXT NOT NULL,        -- image | video | live_photo | raw | other
  mime_type TEXT,
  width INTEGER,
  height INTEGER,
  duration_ms INTEGER,
  capture_date TEXT,
  added_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  missing_at TEXT,
  source_scan_run TEXT,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);
```

```sql
photo_asset_metadata(
  asset_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES photo_assets(asset_id),
  title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  caption TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  favorite INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  hidden INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  deleted_at TEXT,
  date_override TEXT,
  location_override_json TEXT,
  location_hidden INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  edited INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
```

```sql
photo_ocr_blocks(
  block_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES photo_assets(asset_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  text TEXT NOT NULL,
  language TEXT,
  confidence REAL,
  bounds_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
```

```sql
photo_object_tags(
  tag_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES photo_assets(asset_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  label TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL,
  confidence REAL,
  bounds_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
```

```sql
photo_asset_events(
  event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES photo_assets(asset_id),
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,        -- viewed | shared
  event_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  actor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);
```

```sql
photo_album_items(
  album_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES photo_assets(asset_id),
  position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  added_at TEXT NOT NULL,

);
```

```sql
photo_search_fts(
  asset_id UNINDEXED,
  filename,

  caption,
  keywords,
  people,
  location,
  ocr_text,
  model_tags
);
```

```sql
  PRIMARY KEY(asset_id, keyword_id)
);
```

```sql
photo_people_profiles(

);
```

```sql
photo_people_groups(
  group_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  member_people_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  excluded_people_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  key_asset_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  favorite INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  hidden INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  manual_order INTEGER,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);
```

```sql
photo_album_folders(
  folder_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  parent_folder_id TEXT,
  position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

photo_albums(
  album_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  album_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'smart',
  folder_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  folder_position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cover_source_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  rules_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);
```

```sql
photo_duplicate_groups(
  group_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  algorithm TEXT NOT NULL,         -- exact_hash | perceptual_dhash
  signature TEXT NOT NULL,
  item_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  primary_asset_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

photo_duplicate_dismissals(
  algorithm TEXT NOT NULL,
  signature TEXT NOT NULL,
  dismissed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY(algorithm, signature)
);

photo_duplicate_group_items(
  group_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES photo_duplicate_groups(group_id),
  asset_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES photo_assets(asset_id),
  position INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY(group_id, asset_id)
);
```

```sql
photo_import_sessions(
  import_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL,       -- folder | camera | phone | library | app | other
  storage_mode TEXT NOT NULL,      -- managed | referenced
  source_label TEXT NOT NULL,
  root_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  completed_at TEXT,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  imported_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  failed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);

photo_import_failures(
  failure_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  import_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES photo_import_sessions(import_id),
  source_path TEXT NOT NULL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  recovered_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  dismissed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);
```

```sql
photo_operation_journal(
  operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  operation_type TEXT NOT NULL,    -- hide | delete | merge_duplicates | album_edit | metadata_bulk | move
  payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  undo_payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  undone_at TEXT
);
```

The earlier target schema additions in this subsection are now present in the current worktree: `photo_ocr_blocks`, `photo_object_tags`, `photo_edit_stacks`, and `photo_media_pairs`.

Target smart query DSL shape:

```json
{
  "op": "all",
  "conditions": [
    { "field": "favorite", "operator": "is", "value": true },
    { "field": "mediaKind", "operator": "is", "value": "image" },
    {
      "op": "any",
      "conditions": [
        { "field": "person", "operator": "is", "value": "Alice" },
        { "field": "keyword", "operator": "is", "value": "Vacation" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

## Implementation Risks

- Data duplication risk: current core Photos surfaces now read `photo_assets`, but future import, edit, OCR, media-pair, and intelligence jobs must keep `photo_assets` as the unifying index instead of creating parallel truths.
- Performance risk: OCR, hashing, pHash, metadata extraction, and embeddings must be background jobs with pause/resume and progress. Never block the Photos grid on ML jobs.
- Privacy risk: Apple-like intelligence features must be local by default. Any network lookup must be explicit and separable.
- Destructive-action risk: duplicate merge, delete, move, and edit-render output need an operation journal and restore path.
- Migration risk: existing custom albums must retain include/exclude people, rules, covers, and descriptions when migrated to the query DSL.
- UI complexity risk: do not add every Apple control into one panel. Add compact toolbar controls, an inspector, and contextual menus.
- Testing risk: current frontend coverage is not enough for Apple-level workflows. Each phase should add unit, backend, E2E, and migration coverage.

- Node/unit tests for pure UI helpers, query DSL serialization, filter chips, and selection state.

- Performance tests for 10k, scaled 50k, and scaled 100k assets: initial load and search are covered by backend smoke; first-wave desktop and compact browser scroll E2E, virtual-grid 100k/240-sample helper windowing, metadata batch update/list-search/global-search/keyword-list/search-index-rebuild/post-rebuild-search timing, preview rebuild/sweep, missing-original preview rebuild/sweep failure-state, missing-original export selection/contact-sheet timing, OCR sidecar first-batch/drain/status timing, durable OCR worker enqueue/run/status/search timing, and duplicate rebuild/page/rail/invalid-merge/merge/undo/dismiss timing are covered by the perf budget; broader multi-browser/device scroll/preview/export matrices, duplicate browser/device matrices, and future model-backed OCR worker queues still need dedicated coverage.
